surface: The freeze bars: F6 from the grid to a bar, its name and frozen count, the arrows moving it, Home, and Escape back to the grid.

steps.note: F6 in the grid moves the focus to the first freeze bar, a separator next to the grid named by its edge, with the frozen count as its value (2 columns, 2 rows on this page). Finding (known): VoiceOver with Chromium says nothing on the first key of the page. Finding: VoiceOver with WebKit reads the name without the value in some runs, and nothing in others.

ArrowRight moves the start bar one column on: 3 columns frozen. Finding (the grid's): VoiceOver reads the value as a percentage of the bar's range (`43%`, `38%`), never the frozen count: the separator has `aria-valuenow` with a range and no `aria-valuetext`. NVDA reads the count.
ArrowLeft moves it back. Finding (the grid's): VoiceOver reads a percentage here too, as on arrow-grow: the separator has no aria-valuetext.

F6 on a bar moves to the next one, the top bar. Finding: VoiceOver with Chromium reads `horizontal splitter` without the bar's name; VoiceOver with WebKit reads the name in some runs, and nothing in others.
ArrowDown moves the top bar one row down: 3 rows frozen. Finding (the grid's): VoiceOver reads a percentage here too, as on arrow-grow: the separator has no aria-valuetext.
Home unfreezes every row of the edge.
Escape gives the focus back to the grid, on the selected cell. VoiceOver with WebKit says nothing here in some runs.
